free_tier.stated: Devnet uploads are paid with free faucet tokens; 'Devnet ... data retention lasting approximately 60 days before deletion'. Mainnet has no free allowance — storage is metered per byte-second.

retention.stated: data retention lasting approximately 60 days before deletion'

egress.terms: not metered separately; data is served from the destination network (Irys L1). Not quantified on the pages read.

tooling: @irys/upload SDK (TypeScript), plus a storage CLI. Endpoint uploader.irys.xyz (probe GET /info -> 200, version 0.2.0).
chaining: Faucet-funded devnet wallets are cheap to mint, and 60-day retention means rolling re-upload. Volume is bounded by faucet drip, not by a published quota.
limits_note: per-object-cap: not stated. retention: ~60 days on devnet, hard deletion. request-rate: none documented. Binding constraint is faucet economics plus the 60-day retention.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'academic'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence

reliability_note: Irys is retiring its Arweave bundler endpoints (node1.irys.xyz, mainnet.arweave.irys.xyz) on 2026-11-01, so any wrapper built on the Arweave path breaks in ten days.

evidence.proved: 'a devnet bundler for testing with free faucet tokens'; 'data retention lasting approximately 60 days before deletion'
